items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I think I still have that attack. Cause I like it because it -- it -- immediately attracts attention... I think if you're doing something, do it so somebody knows that you're doing it... I got that from Bix Beiderbecke.

ctx.x: I see. Did you ever meet people like Bix Biederbeck?
I met Bix, yes. I met Benny Goodman.
